body:
Greg's direction, relayed by Kimi::Consultant (mailbox 852a55c9 #46, 2026-11-04 21:33Z), not read from Greg directly; it grants no commit, push, install or restart authority. His principle: coordinating 4 machines and agents is hard; don't assume a human designs optimal rules up front. First a complete working loop, however rough; then the system has a measurable goal and optimises itself.

Direction: (1) finish simple EO w-633b5cacc42a and ordinary test, evaluate, done on Windows and Linux before re-enable; (2) remove superseded mechanisms, add no further handshakes; Git is the source, a registered run is execution and result, the evaluator judges the criterion, Engram owns evidence currency, TermAl owns execution and federation; (3) measure the cost of a landed change: tokens, time, Greg's interventions, false refusals, duplicate runs, messages, queue age; (4) small Sol/Opus delegations, one worker plus parent, review on freeze, coordinator for exceptions only; (5) federation as simple transport of exact commit, bundle, mailbox and result, no new bureaucracy.

Goals: 5 ordinary changes end to end on 2 systems with no workaround or false refusal and negatives still refused; superseded procedures removed and fewer states; a baseline, then for example 30% less cost with no weaker tests or review; Greg gets result, blocker or decision, not acknowledgements.

Reporting: don't assume Greg watches agent sessions. Updates for Greg go to Engram::Asistant, which aggregates. Technical status notes and peer mailboxes stay. Apply without a new procedure layer.
